questions.question: What mutual declaration appears in chapter 6?
options: Our love has failed and grown bitterly cold
I am my beloved's and my beloved is mine
I am left all alone in the night
The time has come for us to part
questions.answer: I am my beloved's and my beloved is mine

questions.question: How does the beloved describe the bride's uniqueness?
options: A rival to the other maidens
One of many women he admires

questions.question: In chapter 6 the bride is compared to one as awesome as an army with banners.
I belong to my beloved and he belongs to _____.
My _____, my perfect one, is the only one.
